open_points.subject: NodeExecution (M23) writing ownership
open_points.text: "Every record type has one writing module." / "The record that concludes an operation element ... is built and written by `effects` ... Every other record ... is built and written by `runs`."
open_points.question: Is M23 owned by one module, or intentionally split between `effects` and `runs` by status/path?
options: Single owner: `runs` writes all NodeExecution records, `effects` returns outcome facts only
Split owner: `effects` writes operation-concluding records, `runs` writes all others
open_points.default_guess: Keep the split exactly as later described (`effects` for operation-concluding records, `runs` for the rest).

open_points.subject: StoredValue (M21) writing ownership
open_points.text: "Every record type has one writing module." / "Classes of produced values ... applied by the module that writes the value: `runs` ... `effects` ... `functions` ..."
open_points.question: Who is the writing owner of StoredValue records: one module, or multiple producer modules?
options: Single owner: only one module creates M21 records and others pass raw bytes/facts to it
Distributed ownership: `runs`, `effects`, and `functions` each create M21 records in their domains
open_points.default_guess: Assume distributed ownership by producer modules, with `store` only persisting bytes/records.

open_points.subject: Repair view rule (A15 rule 6) ownership
open_points.text: "`surface` ... assembles ... the repair view of one slot ... from the owning modules' read capabilities and `store.page_records`." / "a value a rule computes ... comes from the owning module's capability, never from `surface` re-deriving it."
open_points.question: Which module owns the computed selection logic for the repair view (latest function-node NodeExecutions pinned to any contract version of the slot, reverse store order, capped): `surface`, `runs`, `functions`, or `store`?
options: `runs` exposes a dedicated capability that already applies A15 rule 6
`store` provides a specialized query capability treated as the owner-facing computation
open_points.default_guess: Implement selection in `surface` using paging/filtering over module reads and `store.page_records`.
